LESSON: MAIN PHYSICAL FEATURES IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and the Built Environments
Topic 1.2: Main physical features in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Main physical features in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can we conserve physical features found in our locality?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa
3. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features
4. value the physical features in the locality

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: MAIN PHYSICAL FEATURES IN EASTERN AFRICA
This lesson teaches Main physical features in Eastern Africa for Grade 6 SOCIAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. value the physical features in the locality
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Main physical features in Eastern Africa using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Main physical features in Eastern Africa above.
2. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Main physical features in Eastern Africa.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Main physical features in Eastern Africa with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Main physical features in Eastern Africa important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we conserve physical features found in our locality?
2. Why are physical features important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa
3. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features
4. value the physical features in the locality
